summary:
Strategic Petroleum Reserve
The Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR) was established in December 1975 as a consequence of the Arab oil embargo of 1973. Its purpose was to have a 700 million barrel reserve of crude oil in the event the United States faced another embargo.
